question.text:
Which of the following statements is/are correct regarding the tightest upper bound of sorting an array of size $=n$?

  1. Mergesort performs $\mathrm{O}($ nlogn $)$ swaps in worst case
     
  2. Bubblesort performs $\mathrm{O}\left(\mathrm{n}^2\right)$ swaps in worst case
     
  3. Selection sort performs $O(n)$ swaps in worst case
     
  4. Counting sort performs $\mathrm{O}(\mathrm{n}+\mathrm{k})$ swaps in worst case where k is the maximum element in the array
